# Booleans

The boolean types [`bool8`](/docs/api/core/booleans#bool8) to [`bool64`](/docs/api/core/booleans#bool64) and the [`bool`](/docs/api/core/booleans#bool) alias, with their width constants. The widths `bool128`, `bool256` and `bool512` are reserved and not implemented yet.

<h2 id="bool"><code>bool</code></h2>

```rux
pub type bool = bool8
```

The default alias of bool8.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Primitives/Bool.rux#L7)

<h2 id="bool8"><code>bool8</code></h2>

```rux
pub intrinsic type bool8;
```

The compiler representation of bool8.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Core/Src/Primitives/Bool8.rux#L7)
